The '''Junobian soft-shell sand flier''',<ref name="Idol">{{JournalCite|12|Idol Intentions}}</ref> also known as the '''Junobian sand flier''', was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Crustacean/Legends|crustaceans]], native to [[Junobia system/Legends|Junobia system]], with delicate, sweet-tasting meat, which was considered a delicaly throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Their meat tasted even better when harvested right after molted, when their new shells were soft enough to eat.
